definitions.unique_loss_positions: exact distinct non-ignored causal targets in the immutable post-pack training corpus after reservations, decontamination, quality/privacy, dedup, split and packing
definitions.total_training_exposures: all non-ignored causal targets actually consumed by optimizer updates, including repeated passes over previously seen unique positions
definitions.repeat_exposures: total_training_exposures minus unique_loss_positions consumed at least once; repeats never increase unique_loss_positions
definitions.effective_data_epochs: total_training_exposures divided by unique_loss_positions when unique_loss_positions is positive

research_reference.meaning: bounded research reference only; not automatic authorization or a universal optimum
research_reference.basis: Muennighoff et al. 2023 reports negligible loss change versus unique data for up to roughly four repeated epochs in the studied data-constrained regime, with diminishing value from further repetition
research_reference.compute_optimal_note: Hoffmann et al. 2022 motivates joint model/data scaling; its token/parameter relation is a planning reference, not a requirement that all planned exposure be unique

model341_planning.interpretation: a 20M-position corpus is a pilot-scale data floor, not sufficient unique data for the 10x/20x/40x exposure arms; any repeated-data campaign requires an explicit preregistered repeat cap and remains separately compute-authorized

launch_handoff.decision_rule: requested exposure above the unique ledger must fail closed unless a separately preregistered repeat policy supplies an explicit maximum effective epoch cap; passing this exposure check alone never authorizes training
